overview: In the mid-1980s, childhood sweethearts Wang Xiaoqing and Du Mantang were separated by Wang Xiaoqing's mother's disapproval. Zhang Zezhong seized the opportunity, but later married the vice principal's daughter for his career. When his social climbing failed and his house was nearly ruined from a failed scheme to inflate its price, he ended up disgraced. Thirty years later, both Du Mantang and Zhang Zezhong work as the managers in a neighborhood. Zhang Zezhong tries to profit from the neighborhood decommercialization, but Du Mantang blocks his plans. Zhang Zezhong's scheme to take over a traditional courtyard under false pretenses is thwarted by the community, leading to his arrest. His daughter Zhang Ting pleads for understanding, revealing his actions were driven by a desire to stop his wife from emigrating. Although forgiven by his neighbors, Zhang Zezhong receives a prison sentence with probation. He later sincerely apologizes and is ultimately forgiven by the neighbors.
title: Not A Big Deal

overview: The Forensic Unit of the Yunxi City Police Department is where the most major and baffling cases converge. Led by Captain Leng Qiming, a team of young, sharp investigative minds—including Ye Qian, Si Yuanlong, Jiao Lei, and Zhang Ziwu—tackles each puzzle. Among them are profilers who decode the human psyche, tech wizards who master every piece of forensic equipment, seasoned detectives with old-school wisdom, and a slick, quick-witted rookie who provides much-needed levity. United by the principle "To decipher death's code is to guard life's dignity," they each bring a unique skill set to the table. As they peel back the layers of one bewildering crime after another, they expose not just the truth but the raw nature of those involved. Yet just when one mystery seems solved, another emerges from within it. Step by step, as the truth comes to light, so too does the real face of human nature.
title: The Truth

overview: This is a story about the youth of 17-year-old boys, and how they harvest love, friendship and family affection in their last step towards adulthood. When transfer student Sheng Xia first entered the Affiliated High School of South China University of Technology, she met the school's celebrity Zhang Shu, a legend from a poor student to a god of learning. She misunderstood him as a bad academic bully who "held multiple positions", and he also noticed this soft but slightly temperamental transfer student. Sheng Xia, who had just arrived, faced the higher-intensity learning environment of the Affiliated High School of South China University of Technology, coupled with the opposition between her divorced parents on education issues, she felt very hard, but she still stubbornly held on. Fortunately, in the warm collective of Class 6 of Senior 3, there are good friends who can relieve her inner anxiety like a calf, and there are classmates who can encourage her with fun and decompression. More importantly, like his name, Zhang Shu is like a timely rain that falls on her barren and dry world. The throbbing of youth spreads this summer. They cherish each other. There are figures riding bicycles on Xiangzhang Avenue, there are moments when they look back at each other in the teaching building, there are deeds of young people going against the flow and being brave in Yifang Bookstore, and there are his bold words under the national flag... The teenagers encourage each other and go through the time of senior year together. From teenagers to young adults, they each hold their ideals in their hearts and stride forward, just like this hot summer, shining and dazzling. The story of boys and girls working together to overcome the difficulty of the college entrance examination and rushing from school uniforms to wedding dresses.
title: Summer in Your Name

overview: News and Views was an early American evening news program. Broadcast on ABC from 1948 to 1951, it was ABC's first evening news program and one of the first such programs on any television network.
title: News and Views

overview: After the Deadlines was an American evening news program of the early 1950s.
title: After the Deadlines

overview: With unparalleled resources, World News Tonight with Diane Sawyer provides the latest information and analysis of major events from around the country and the world.
title: ABC World News with Diane Sawyer

overview: Get the latest news stories and headlines from around the world.
title: World News with Charles Gibson

overview: Anchors of the program during the early 1960s, sometimes for short periods, included Alex Dreier, John Secondari, Fendall Winston Yerxa, Al Mann, Bill Shadel, and the three-person team of John Cameron Swayze (formerly of NBC), Bill Lawrence, and Bill Sheehan.
title: ABC Evening Report
World News Tonight with Peter Jennings
World News Tonight with Bob Woodruff and Elizabeth Vargas

overview: In 1962, Ron Cochran was appointed as full-time anchor, staying with the program, entitled, "Ron Cochran with the News", until 1965.
title: Ron Cochran with the News

overview: In the fall of 1953, John Daly began anchoring the then-15-minute John Daly and the News. Daly, who served as host of the CBS game show What's My Line? contemporaneously, anchored the newscast until 1960, with multiple hosts and formats succeeding him.
title: John Daly and the News

overview: DJ-producer Carly Foxx is on a musical journey, immersing herself in the life of five iconic European cities to find inspiration.
title: City Beats

overview: Welcome to Dracula's castle. Two teams are trapped overnight and must find their way out by locating the key through mental and physical challenges.
title: Dracula: Escape the Castle

overview: Shen Jia Lan, once a nobleman's granddaughter, falls from grace after her family is falsely accused of treason. Abandoned by her fiancé Lin Jin Qi, she is forced to assume a servant's identity in his household. Despite hardships, she refuses to bow to fate. With resilience and wit, she rises above class barriers, wins Lin Jin Qi's heart, earns the family's respect, and ultimately clears her family's name.
title: Against the Current

overview: In this powerful teaching series, Christine Caine will equip and empower you to live out your divine destiny and become all God has created you to be.
title: Equip & Power with Christine Caine

overview: KDD - Kriminaldauerdienst is a German television series that was broadcast from 2007 to 2010. The series differs from typical police procedurals by focusing on the daily work life and the private problems of the main characters instead of following a "case of the week" scheme, and because of the overarching storylines spanning one or several seasons. Due to its uncommon dramaturgy and its ambiguous drawing of the main characters, it was critically lauded and received several accolades. However, as the number of spectators remained behind expectations, the series was canceled after three seasons.
title: KDD - Kriminaldauerdienst

overview: Flagship EWTN series hosted by Mother Angelica, mother-superior of a Franciscan cloistered monastery and the founder of EWTN network. Features Bible studies, catechetical homilies, a live studio audience, guests and call-in questions.
title: Mother Angelica Live

overview: In this series of short films, Nature is given a voice to raise awareness that people need nature in order to survive.
title: Nature Is Speaking

overview: AM America was a morning news program produced by ABC
title: AM America

overview: The charming and wealthy young master of the Jin family, Jin Xiaobao, though a lover of beauty, is also humorous and considerate, always yearning for a good match. On a dark and windy night, his ideal partner suddenly appears before him! The beautiful and cold-hearted Miss Huaien, however, is embroiled in a deadly crisis. How could Xiaobao pass up the chance to play the hero? But instead of winning the beauty as his bride, he ends up compromising himself! This "beauty" not only has a mysterious gender but also an entangled history with the Jin family. When Xiaobao and Huaien finally come to understand each other, will they still have the courage to continue their romance?
title: Meet You at the Blossom

overview: Akemi Ninomiya is a hardcore mystery fan. Although she is only a college student, she is wealthy and owns a building. Private Detective Morio Ukai prefers tracking down lost pets for wealthy clients rather than murder cases which brings in little money. The duo join forces to solve various suspicious cases.
title: Watashi no kiraina tantei

overview: Arab psychologist, Louie Mansur, is left to raise his two children on his own following the crushing suicide of his wife, who long-suffered a battle with depression. Louie's 13-year-old son, Amir, begins to fail his studies and is on the cusp of dropping out, whilst Louie's daughter, Nur, suffers from agonizing abandonment issues and refuses to leave Louie's side. Louie is left with no time to mourn, as his fatherly duties become all consuming. In an unconventional turn of events, after yet another sleepless night, Louie decides to transfer his clinic hours to the wee hours of the night, accepting patients from dusk till dawn. An eclectic mix of Tel Aviv's nocturnal creatures attends his clinic, along with their compelling stories throughout the series.
title: Night Therapy

overview: A musical parody show, where the stars of domestic show business joke, sing and amuse the audience exclusively "our way"!
title: Всё по-нашему!)

overview: A delinquent 2nd-year student becomes the chairman of the board of a prestigious high school left behind by his father. Na Yi Soo may have grown up in an environment that others would envy, but he harbors hatred for his father and heads to Balhae High School, which his father cherished, in order to seek revenge. The process of change between Yi Soo, who has lived a rougher life than anyone else, and the nation's most elite students who have lived upright lives, as they get to know each other, and the love that blooms in the process, will be dynamically unfolded.
title: The Chairman of Class 9

overview: Graduate students in the Historical Museum find a diary dated 1919. In the diary, the author confesses to the murder of five people. The terrible deeds of the past are the key to unraveling a number of crimes committed in our day.
title: Дневник убийцы

overview: Jai Mahendran is an original political drama series.
title: Jai Mahendran

overview: Zakir Khan, along with his four panelists - Shweta Tiwari, Rithvik Dhanjani, Gopal Datt and Paresh Ganatra, host quirky news debates, candid conversations with celebrities and influencers, and special guests who present their unique talents.
title: Aapka Apna Zakir

overview: Pill unravels the deep-set rot in the Indian pharmaceutical industry. Dr. Prakash along with three whistle-blowers face a powerful pharma giant Forever Cure to expose the corrupt nexus of pharma, middlemen, and doctors through which a pill reaches the common man. Will the good be able to overcome the evil?
title: Pill

overview: A hilarious word association game hosted by the multi-talented Stephen Mangan. Featuring Alan Carr and Daisy May Cooper as resident Team Captains, each episode sees Alan and Daisy pair up with contestants to give one-word clues that aim to help their teammate guess a mystery ‘password'. The teams must try to get on each other's wavelengths as they take it in turns to guess the all-important password across multiple rounds - hilarious clues and even funnier guesses are all that stand in the way of lucky contestants being in with a chance to win a big cash prize.
title: Password

overview: Contestants compete to secure an exclusive mentorship with the UK's favourite fashion retailer - M&S, as well as have their winning design sold at M&S.
title: M&S: Dress The Nation

overview: The story of Ermak Timofeevich, whose campaign for the Ural mountains served to annex the Siberian lands to the Moscow kingdom, in the second half of the 16th century.
title: Ермак

overview: In the comedy series Pastewka, Bastian Pastewka plays Bastian Pastewka in stories of everyday life. Stories that could happen in in real life. Bastian is a lovable douchebag with blossoming imagination, the unconditional desire to always do everything right, a few little quirks and the talent to say the right thing - in most inappropriate moments.
title: Pastewka

overview: A young woman named Lyudmila works in a remote taiga reserve. She carries out a difficult man's task alone, holding the post of Deputy Director for Science. Her father once held this position, but he died... Now Lyuda has to fight poachers and save the taiga deer population. But what to do if bandits are increasingly shooting animals, threatening the management of the reserve, and cowardly management is in no hurry to come to the aid of employees? There is taiga for 500 kilometers around. There is nowhere to wait for salvation... Luda decides to figure everything out herself. A brave woman must single-handedly confront an entire gang of poachers...
title: Нежный барс

overview: In 2007, the Ice Goblins, led by Danacus, invaded Earth. Despite facing unexpected human resistance, the war lasted for years. However, everything changed when an unforeseen meteor crashed into a city twelve years later. From the supernatural ashes of the rubble, a group of teens rose to power and defeated Danacus. Yet, the retreat of the alien invader signals a looming return. In 2024, rising crime and Skorpion activity hint at his comeback. The "Dragonights" series follows their struggle, a tale of intergalactic conflict, human resilience, and globally recognized heroes.
title: Dragonights

overview: Police detective Ian Ridley's life fell apart 11 years ago when his young daughter, Maggie, disappeared without a trace. Now working as a police dispatcher, the only thing that has kept him going is his implacable refusal to accept that she might be gone forever. When he receives a distress call from a teenage girl he is certain is Maggie, he will stop at nothing to find her and reunite his broken family, whatever the cost.
title: Last Seen

overview: Devon thinks her sister Simone has a really creepy relationship with her new boss, the enigmatic socialite Michaela Kell. Michaela's cult-ish life of luxury is like a drug to Simone, and Devon has decided it's time for an intervention, but she has no idea what a formidable opponent Michaela will be. Told over the course of one explosive weekend at The Kells' lavish beach estate, Sirens is an incisive, sexy, and darkly funny exploration of women, power, and class.
title: Sirens

overview: Hailed the "King of Zanzibar" for his luxury travel destination, Wojtek Żabiński's high society life crashes to a halt when he's accused of fraud.
title: Król Zanzibaru

overview: The friendly Koshkin family starts their own business and opens a private family cafe called "Strawberry". The heroes of the series manage to get into different comical situations, and very diverse cafe visitors help them in this.
title: Клубничка

overview: Igor Dzhabrailov and Dmitry Zhuravlev invite guests to play an improv card game
title: Звёздный дурак

overview: Preschool drama about the parallel lives of parents at work and their children who stay with warm-hearted minder Granny Murray.
title: Me Too!

overview: Teen Torture Inc. follows on-going efforts to expose America's "troubled teen" industry (TTI). For six decades and counting, this billion-dollar business has used what it calls "tough love" as a form of treatment despite numerous deaths, countless suicides, life-altering injuries, and instances of child sexual abuse. Until recently, nobody has been able to stop it. The series follows a recurring band of young survivors and whistleblowers and their harrowing first-hand accounts of extreme abuse and cult-like brainwashing at the hands of these programs, starting a social media firestorm in 2021. Survivors, including rap star Bhad Bhabie, are determined to take down this business once and for all. While they have seen impressive victories, the "troubled teen" industry has long been protected by power and is not going down without a fight.
title: Teen Torture, Inc.

overview: Wednesday is all grown up and has finally moved out of her family's manor to experience adult life in Los Angeles. She looks for an apartment, goes on job interviews, internet dates and encounters some unfortunate antagonists along the way.
title: Adult Wednesday Addams

overview: Wiggin' Out with Tokyo Stylez follows Tokyo as she takes center stage, shaping hair dreams into reality one strand at a time. This series gives viewers an inside look as Tokyo meets with, curates and installs wigs for high-profile clientele such as Cardi B, Trina Braxton, Reginae Carter, TS Madison, Tiffany "New York" Pollard, AriFletcher, FloMilliand more. Each episode showcases Tokyo's unique creative process, from the first stitch to the final transformative installation. Each wig comes with its own set of challenges, and Tokyo must balance deadlines, client demands and finding time for life outside of the salon.
title: Wiggin' Out with Tokyo Stylez

overview: Strange & Suspicious digs deep into the world of unexplained, unsolved, downright weird stories from across the globe with the help of a retired cop, a private investigator, an archaeologist, a UFO investigator, a mathematician, and others.
title: Strange & Suspicious

overview: EastEnders is working on a new storyline that will see Anna Knight (Molly Rainford) get her drink spiked. Anna is set to find herself in danger later this summer when she gets spiked whilst on a night out at Peggy's. With her friends believing that Anna's behaviour is down to alcohol, the incident initially goes unnoticed, but Anna's friends soon become concerned for her welfare when they realise that her behaviour does not equate to the little amount of alcohol she has actually consumed… In a digital first for EastEnders, an exclusive five part mini-series will be made accessible to viewers via a QR code that will feature within the main episode which will take the audience to a link giving them the option of which platform to watch through. The digital series will offer a unique insight as viewers see the incident from Anna's own perspective, and from the perspective of her friends. As Anna grapples with her detachment from reality, viewers of the mini-series will experience the internal warning signs to look out for when spiked, whereas additional footage captured by Anna's friends will showcase the outward effects the drugs have on her behaviour and mobility.
title: Spiked

overview: All Star News in 1952
title: All-Star News

overview: A simple newly wed bride gets deceived and abandoned by her NRI groom, takes charge of herself overcomes deceit and restores her and her family's respect and charts for herself a 'New Life'.
title: Megha Barsenge

overview: Follow the unpredictable and exciting journey of BTS's Jimin and Jung Kook!
title: Are You Sure?

overview: The breaking news of a big Bollywood actor committing suicide sparks controversial conversations in living rooms across the country including the Murthys living a quiet life in Bengaluru. Nisha and Shiv Murthy, a pair of siblings, embark on a complex self-discovery journey trying to navigate their way through the beast of social media and the race to stay relevant. Through humor and relatable situations, Murthys explores the complexities of family dynamics in today's digital age. This coming-of-age series is about the impact of the toxic news cycle on young adults.
title: Primetime with the Murthys

overview: Lee Anderson brings the Real World to the Great British public, as the silent majority finally have their voices heard in the Conservative deputy chairman's brand-new current affairs show.
title: Lee Anderson's Real World

overview: Marshall Matt Dillon is responsible for keeping the law and respectability in Dodge City in this western action-drama. Gunsmoke captured the courage, character and spirit of the Western Frontier.
title: Gunsmoke

overview: How animal parents teach their babies survival skills that help them thrive in the changing seasons.
title: Oh Baby!

overview: When his father is arrested for murdering two children, Paul Spruit is still an adolescent. From that moment on, normal life is no longer possible for the Spruit family. Then they have to deal with the violent ex-husband of Paul's mother. Because reports do nothing, Paul takes the law into his own hands: in a blind rage he stabs his stepfather to death.
title: Een moord kost meer levens

overview: A merchant has three children; Salem, Salim, and Gawdar. However, the life of the last son, Gawdar, becomes complicated, and he comes into conflict with the enemy Shimoun to reach the four treasures of the wiseman Shamardal.
title: Gawdar

overview: Cheng Tang, once the promising eldest grandson of the Cheng family, was driven out and nearly killed by scheming enemies. But instead of giving up, he was taken in by Mr. Lin as his live-in son-in-law. Coincidentally, Lin Chuxue, the heroine, was his childhood savior. Though she sees him as only a nominal husband, Cheng Tang hides his true identity, growing stronger and plotting his return to the Cheng family while protecting Lin Chuxue. In the end, he achieves a fulfilling love.
title: He is from The Cheng Group

overview: Filmed over three years, this raw and honest documentary series follows Ireland's top medal prospects as they strive to qualify for the Olympic and Paralympic Games.
title: Path to Paris

overview: Doctor Lada, whose alias is angel doctor, was left with a scar on her heart by old love, causing her to be unable to open up for someone anymore. She must reunite with Earn, that ex-girlfrend who hurt her heart the worst, when she becomes a new presenter for the hospital where she works.
title: The Secret of Us

overview: Yun Feifei, a detective from Liushanmen, and Gu Linyuan, a high-ranking member of the Qiankun Gang, are sworn enemies. However, after uncovering each other's true identities, they realize they are long-lost lovers with deep emotional ties. As they rekindle their romance, the mysteries of the past gradually unravel.
title: Lost You, Found You

overview: Upstairs, Downstairs is a British television drama series originally produced by London Weekend Television and revived by the BBC. Set in a large townhouse in Edwardian, First World War and interwar Belgravia in London, the series depicts the lives of the servants "downstairs" and their masters—the family "upstairs". Great events feature prominently in the episodes but minor or gradual changes are also noted. The series stands as a document of the social and technological changes that occurred between 1903 and 1930. The series follows the lives of both the family and the servants in the London townhouse at 165 Eaton Place. Richard Bellamy, the head of the household, is a member of Parliament, and his wife a member of the titled aristocracy. Belowstairs, Hudson, the Scottish butler directs and guides the other servants about their tasks and (sometimes) their proper place. Real-life events from 1903-1930 are incorporated into the stories of the Bellamy household.
title: Upstairs, Downstairs

overview: Raising Fame delves beyond the glitz and glamour to provide a unique perspective in the words of both the parents and celebrated children themselves.
title: Raising Fame

overview: A former Army surgeon moves back to her hometown and joins a practice of family doctors, but when she's drawn into solving the mysterious death of a patient, her quiet life becomes upended.
title: Family Practice Mysteries

overview: A summary of the latest news headlines.
title: Sky News at 7pm

overview: A cryptic call about a planned jewelry heist draws a Detroit Free Press tipline operator, Maddie Moore, into a dangerous homicide case alongside a newly promoted detective.
title: Tipline Mysteries

overview: Ibiza Narcos is the story of how a tiny, sleepy Mediterranean Island was transformed into one the world's most vibrant party capitals, fuelled by a dangerous and lucrative drugs trade which drew as many criminals to its shores as it did party animals.
title: Ibiza Narcos

overview: Because of her bandaged face, she is called Mummy in the children's ward. In two months, disfigured Anya had to seriously grow up. Before the accident, she was a beautiful, confident schoolgirl. Afterwards - a closed, cynical creature, ready to attack even those who are trying to help her. Every day Anya looks for new reasons to live on and new tricks to stay in the hospital. After all, she recently had a goal - to kill the culprit who was lying in a coma in the very accident in which her parents died. To carry out her plan, Anya gathers a team of loser patients, but in the process of preparation she realizes that revenge is not a cure.
title: Ненормальная

overview: Tsukioka Natsu is 28 years old. He works for a printing company in Tokyo. One day, Tsukioka Natsu hears that Nagumo Mizuki died. They were in a romantic relationship when they attended the same university. They broke up after Nagumo Mizuki suddenly told him that she wanted to end their relationship, and she disappeared afterwards. He didn't hear anything about her for the past 7 years after their breakup. Tsukioka Natsu attends Nagumo Mizuki's funeral, where he meets a young child named Umi. He is surprised to learn that Umi is Mizuki Nagumo's daughter. Nagumo Mizuki's mother talks to him and tells him that Umi is his daughter.
title: The Beginning of the Sea

overview: Born To is a series of life-affirming short films, which tell emotionally-charged stories of talented and successful athletes at the top of their game.
title: Born To

overview: Haunted by guilt and doubt, Ryu flees Japan for Berlin and is saved by Korean boxer Johan. Their chance encounter binds their destiny for years to come.
title: Soul Mate

overview: When a missing high school student is found shackled in chains off the shore of Cape May, investigators are baffled by what kind of monster could commit such a heinous murder. Their investigation leads them to uncover jealous boyfriends and turmoil within the victim's foster family that sends shockwaves throughout the tightknit community.
title: Bodies in the Water

overview: Sasha Reid and the Midnight Order follows Reid and her secret society who share a common obsession - the dark psychology of those who commit harm and the desire to protect those that law enforcement has ignored. They band together to work outside the system to protect the vulnerable, solve cold cases, and dive into the dark minds of killers using forensic expertise and world-class data skills. Their motto is to have compassion first, but let the evidence lead.
title: Sasha Reid and the Midnight Order

overview: HOMIES is an entertaining quiz in which two pairs of friends compete in the ability to understand each other. The show consists of several rounds, which are united by one goal – to understand how well each participant knows the way his friend thinks.
title: ХОУМИС

overview: The story takes place in a typical Beijing community: ancient buildings and new functions are integrated and overlapped, new and old residents live next to each other, and community work is complicated.
title: One Step Forward

overview: At the end of the last century, Wanshan Special Zone in Guizhou was facing a desperate situation due to the depletion of mercury resources. Feng Baiyang, a third-generation mercury miner, held a strong sense of responsibility and mission, and achieved transformation and development based on technological innovation and green development, making a resource-depleted city reborn from the ashes and making the dream of innovative development come true.
title: The Rise of Wanshan

overview: This docuseries digs into the disappearance of 13-year-old Yara and the disconcerting investigation that shattered the peace of a small Italian town.
title: Il caso Yara: oltre ogni ragionevole dubbio

overview: How to Die Alone follows Melissa, a fat, Black neurotic who's never been in love. After a comical brush with death, she refuses to settle for anything less than the life she wants, catapulting her on a journey to becoming "100% that bitch" in real life by any means necessary.
title: How to Die Alone

overview: Riding Phat follows the Phat Scooters team as they design, build, and deliver awesome electric scooters to celebrity clients and people who love to Ride Phat!
title: Riding Phat

overview: Only When I Laugh is a British television sitcom made by Yorkshire Television for ITV. It aired between 29 October 1979 and 16 December 1982 and was set in the ward of an NHS hospital. The title is in response to the question, "Does it hurt?" It starred James Bolam, Peter Bowles, and Christopher Strauli as patients Roy Figgis, Archie Glover, and Norman Binns. Mr. Gordon Thorpe, their consultant surgeon, was played by Richard Wilson; and Gupte, the staff nurse from Delhi, was played by Derrick Branche. The show was one of many successes for writer Eric Chappell, and has been repeated on ITV3 since 2007. Roy, Archie and Norman are long-term patients in a British hospital ward. Though they don't seem terribly ill, neither do they seem to be getting better and going home. So they pass their days side by side in the hospital ward, chatting and occasionally getting on one another's nerves.
title: Only When I Laugh

overview: We are joining Alexander and Mina (6) on another long trip. This time, little sister Lilje (3) also gets to join her very first winter expedition.
title: Mina, Lilje og meg
